post.description:
Transfer specified MTB product to a traveller.
If the recipient is specified by e-mail then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
an e-mail is sent notifying the recipient.
If the recipient is specified by phone number then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
a SMS is sent notifying the recipient.
If the e-mail or phone number isn't registered then the request is denied or a
notification is sent with a message that a registration is necessary to receive
the mtb_product. This is system configurable.
If the recipient is specified by traveller ID then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
no notification is sent.
If the recipient is specified by smartcard serial/token ID then the product is assigned to the
specified card and no notification is sent. If the card is not assigned to a traveller or vendor,
then an anonymous traveller is created for this smartcard.

Transfer specified MTB products.
If the recipient is specified by e-mail then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
an e-mail is sent notifying the recipient.
If the recipient is specified by phone number then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
an SMS is sent notifying the recipient.
If the e-mail or phone number isn't registered then the request is denied or a
notification is sent with a message that a registration is necessary to receive
the mtb_product. This is system configurable.
If the recipient is specified by traveller ID then the product is assigned to the
travellers preferred mtb_bearer (or unassigned if there is no preferred) and
no notification is sent.
If the recipient is specified by smartcard serial/token ID then the product is assigned to the
specified card and no notification is sent. If the card is not assigned to a traveller or vendor,
then an anonymous traveller is created for this smartcard.
